subject: Project update
snippet: Hi Shanice, wanted to give you a quick update on the after-school tutoring rollo...
body:
Hi Shanice, wanted to give you a quick update on the after-school tutoring rollout. We've got 42 students signed up so far across both grade bands, which is ahead of where we projected. The main snag is still room availability on Tuesdays since the gym is booked for volleyball.

Can you take a look at the numbers when you get a chance and let me know if you think we need to open a waitlist? I'd rather figure that out now than scramble in September.

subject: Re: Project update
snippet: This is great news, Valerie, thank you for staying on top of it. 42 is honestly ...
body:
This is great news, Valerie, thank you for staying on top of it. 42 is honestly more than I expected this early. Let's plan on a waitlist just so we're not caught off guard, and I can ask facilities about the library annex as a backup space for Tuesdays.

Can you send me the grade breakdown before our meeting Thursday? I want to loop in the district liaison if numbers keep climbing.

subject: Team meeting Thursday
snippet: Hi Shanice, I'm putting together the agenda for Thursday's team meeting. So far ...
body:
Hi Shanice, I'm putting together the agenda for Thursday's team meeting. So far I have: tutoring program update, spring testing calendar, and the staff appreciation lunch planning. Anything you want to add before I send it out to the group?

Also wondering if we should cap it at 45 minutes this time since last week ran long.

subject: Re: Team meeting Thursday
snippet: Thanks for pulling that together. Let's add a short item on the substitute teach...
body:
Thanks for pulling that together. Let's add a short item on the substitute teacher shortage — I've had three department heads mention it to me this week and I think it's worth five minutes of visibility.

45 minutes sounds right, especially if we keep the appreciation lunch discussion brief and just ask for volunteers instead of debating logistics live.

subject: Re: Team meeting Thursday
snippet: Good call on the substitute shortage, I'll add it right after the testing calend...
body:
Good call on the substitute shortage, I'll add it right after the testing calendar item. I'll send the final agenda out this afternoon and note the 45-minute target so people know to keep comments tight.

See you Thursday!

subject: Staff 1:1 prep
snippet: Shanice, before our 1:1s with the grade-level leads next week, do you want me to pull the mid-year data sheets ahead of time? I'd rather...
body: Shanice, before our 1:1s with the grade-level leads next week, do you want me to pull the mid-year data sheets ahead of time? I'd rather walk in with something concrete than wing it.

body: Yes, please pull the mid-year sheets — I always appreciate having the numbers in front of us instead of a vague check-in. Let's keep each one to twenty minutes: one win, one worry, one next step. Thank you, Valerie.

subject: Re: Staff 1:1 prep

body: Perfect. I'll have the sheets in the shared folder by Friday and block the conference room for us. I'll put one win, one worry, one next step at the top of each page so we stay on track.

body: That's exactly right. If any of the leads flag a coverage gap, note it and we'll fold it into the testing-window plan. See you Monday.

See you Tuesday, can't wait!

Also tell me honestly if you'd rather keep it small, I just don't want you to spend your birthday doing nothing again like last year.

What day were you thinking? My actual birthday falls on a Tuesday this year so probably the Saturday before makes more sense.

Saturday before works perfectly, I'll check if the rooftop takes reservations for groups that size. I'm thinking Tasha, Renee, your cousin Angela, and maybe Marcus if he's around that weekend. Let me know if I'm missing anyone from your must-invite list.

Also no presents talk yet, but I do want to know if there's a color scheme happening or if that's too much lol.

Thank you for doing this, seriously. You always make sure I don't just let these things slide by unnoticed.
